instruction: Export this image as a PSD file with all layer effects preserved in GIMP.

metadata.explanation: While GIMP can open and export PSD files, it has limited support for Photoshop-specific layer effects (drop shadows, bevels, overlays, etc.). GIMP does not have native layer effects/styles like Photoshop, so there are no layer effects to preserve. The concept of 'layer effects' as a feature doesn't exist in GIMP's architecture.
